verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own channel docs cover inbound access control: the Telegram page says it "sets who is all[owed]" to talk to the bot, and the WhatsApp page lists "access controls" as a documented topic. That supports first-party sender gating on at least two channels, but the snippets are truncated and give no detail on how it works. missing for 10: explicit sender-allowlist configuration details, documented DM policy options, mention gating for group channels, coverage across the other channels (Discord, Slack, Signal, etc.), independent or hands-on corroboration.
